title: The Bear Who Joined The Army
description:
Wojtek was a Syrian brown bear bought as a cub by Polish soldiers in Iran in 1942. He liked beer and cigarettes, was officially drafted as a private so he could travel with his unit, and during the Battle of Monte Cassino in 1944 is said to have carried ammunition crates. He was promoted to corporal and spent the rest of his life at Edinburgh Zoo.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Wojtek'. The crate-carrying story is debated.

What other animal should get a rank? Tell us in the comments.
